meta: Concept site for Quarter Turn Auto Repair, a made-up Grand Rapids, Michigan auto repair shop: brakes, diagnostics, oil changes, suspension and winter prep at posted prices. Designed by shash.builds.

hero.title: Fixed right. Priced up front.
hero.sub: Brakes, check-engine lights, suspension and Michigan winter prep. We show you the problem, the photo and the price before we turn a wrench.

area.title: Grand Rapids and the suburbs.
area.note: Free rides to home or work within 5 miles of the shop while your car is in.

about.title: A shop that shows its work.
body: Most people walk out of a repair shop not sure what was wrong or whether it needed fixing at all.
We text you photos of every problem, explain it in plain words and price each fix on its own. You decide what gets done today and what can wait.

promise.title: 12 months or 12,000 miles on every repair.
promise.body: Parts and labor, in writing. If the same repair fails inside that window, we fix it again at no cost.

faq: It helps. Booked cars get looked at first, but we take walk-ins for quick jobs like oil changes and tire swaps.
How will I know what's wrong?
We text photos and a short note for every problem, with the price to fix each one. Nothing gets done without your OK.
Can I bring my own parts?
For some jobs, yes. We can't warranty the part itself, only our labor.
Do you work on all makes?
Most domestic and import cars, SUVs and light trucks. Call if you're not sure.
How do I get home while my car is in?
We'll drive you anywhere within 5 miles of the shop and pick you up when it's ready.

form.title: What's the car doing?
form.note: Tell us the make, the model and what you're hearing or seeing. We'll call back with a time and a ballpark.
